verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is built around a documented public API. Its Unified Payments API covers the full payment lifecycle, and the docs cover OAuth 2.0 client credentials and secret-key auth, idempotent retries on named endpoints, adaptive rate limits, an FX rates API, and webhook management through the API. An official Node.js SDK and an API reference exposed through the MCP server support this further. missing for 10: an OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
